channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: ‘Decepcionado’ com o PL, vice é trunfo de Renan Santos na pauta da segurança
item.description: Renan Santos, pre-candidate for president from the Missão party (founded by MBL), formally announced retired Colonel Aroldo Medina as his running mate at an event in São Paulo. Medina, a former PL member disillusioned with Bolsonaro’s pandemic response, was selected to bolster the ticket on public security and appeal to military and police voters. He stated he felt 'disappointed' and 'boycotted' by the PL for being independent.

item.title: Kassab diz que não é oportunismo PSD ter cargos no governo Lula
item.description: PSD president Gilberto Kassab defended that the party's participation in Lula's government is not opportunism, as its members supported Lula in the 2022 elections. He cited ministers such as Carlos Fávaro, André de Paula, Alexandre Silveira, Otto Alencar, and Antônio Brito as examples of allies who chose to back Lula and now hold government positions. Kassab stated it is natural for these figures to participate in Lula's 2026 re-election campaign.

item.title: “A gente não pode perder o foco”, diz Nikolas ao lado de Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) stated that supporters of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) must not lose focus on the goal of defeating President Lula (PT) in the 2026 presidential race. The comment was made during a PL communication seminar in Rio de Janeiro, amid growing internal tensions within the party.

item.title: Em crise com Flávio, Michelle elogia política do governo Lula
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro praised the National Policy for Bilingual Education of the Deaf (PNEBS) launched by the Lula government, emphasizing autonomy and leadership for the deaf community. She made the comment amid a family conflict with her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro, stating she felt humiliated and disrespected during a phone conversation with him.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que Lula “quer deixar o Brasil igual a Cuba”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) claimed that President Lula wants to make Brazil like Cuba, during a Liberal Party event in Rio de Janeiro alongside city councilwoman Zoe Martinez, who was born in Cuba and identifies as anti-communist. He accused Lula of envy toward Cubans suffering from hunger and pledged to restore Brazilians' purchasing power, stating that salaries no longer cover basic grocery costs.

item.title: Sanções de Trump a pessoas e empresas supostamente ligadas ao PCC bombam nas redes
item.description: U.S. Treasury sanctions on two Brazilians and three companies allegedly linked to the PCC sparked 362,000 social media interactions from Thursday morning to today, including 34,000 Portuguese mentions on X and 900 on Facebook/Instagram. The Federal Police arrested Stella Stefanie, one of the sanctioned individuals, in Operation Exchange, while opposition figures and Lula’s allies traded accusations of electoral opportunism, with conservatives praising the sanctions as a 'necessary lifeline' and the government denouncing political exploitation of the issue.

item.title: Com Bruno Henrique e Pedro, veja escalação do Flamengo contra o River
item.description: Flamengo debuts in the Algarve Trophy against River Plate this Friday (July 3) at 3:30 p.m. Brasília time, as part of a pre-season friendly tournament. The Rio de Janeiro side fields its strongest available lineup under coach Leonardo Jardim, featuring Bruno Henrique and Pedro as forwards, alongside Rossi, E. Royal, João Victor, Vitão, Ayrton Lucas, Erick, Jorginho, Luiz Araújo and Samuel Lino. The only absences are players called up for the 2026 World Cup.

item.title: Lula faz pacote de anúncios na véspera das restrições eleitorais
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced a package of actions in health, education, and housing across 12 states on the eve of the electoral blackout period, which began July 4, 2026. The event at the Planalto Palace featured the inauguration of 10 new Federal Institutes with R$206.6 million in investments and R$464.8 million allocated to public health, including the 'Agora Tem Especialistas' program. Lula stressed education as a government priority, banned the term 'expense' in that context, and noted he may only visit (not speak about) projects during the blackout, which lasts until October 25.

item.title: PT reduz verba do fundão para Lula e aumenta em 5 vezes para senadores
item.description: The PT reduced its allocation from the Electoral Fund (fundão) for President Lula’s re-election campaign from 26.03% in 2022 to 20.64% in 2026, amounting to approximately R$126 million, down from R$130.9 million in the previous election. At the same time, the party significantly increased funding for Senate candidacies, from 2.48% (R$12.4 million) to 10.08% (R$61.9 million), nearly quintupling the amount. This redistribution reflects a strategic shift by the party to strengthen its Senate caucus while maintaining substantial, though reduced, support for the presidential candidacy.

item.title: Lula faz pacote de entregas antes da restrição imposta pelo período eleitoral
item.description: President Lula and Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, pre-candidates for re-election in 2026, led a nationwide task force of inaugurations and deliveries on Friday (July 3), one day before the electoral blackout period began. The event included the inauguration of ten federal institute units, alongside initiatives in health, credit (Desenrola Adimplentes), and agriculture (Plano Safra), with participation from ministers and political allies across 12 cities in seven states. The mobilization reflects a government strategy to consolidate achievements before legal restrictions on institutional advertising during the electoral period take effect.

item.title: Pesquisa AtlasIntel mostra impacto da crise Michelle x Flávio na disputa presidencial
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll shows that 64.1% of respondents believe the public conflict between Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro weakened the senator's candidacy, while only 9.2% see it as strengthening. Among Jair Bolsonaro voters, 65.6% disapprove of Michelle's video release, revealing a deep split within the Bolsonarist base. The PL also suffered, as Michelle played a strategic role in mobilizing women and conservative voters, and her withdrawal undermines Flávio's campaign.

item.title: Fachin altera data de julgamento sobre a eleição para o governo do Rio
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin moved up the ruling on the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election to August 19 after Minister Flávio Dino returned the case and cleared it for plenary discussion. The case concerns succession following the resignations and removals of Cláudio Castro, Thiago Pampolha, and Rodrigo Bacellar, leaving TJ-RJ President Ricardo Couto as interim governor. As the STF has not yet ruled on direct vs. indirect election, the PSD demands a direct vote, while ministers Fux, Mendonça, and Marques advocate for indirect and secret voting.

item.title: Flávio adia decisão sobre nome que concorrerá ao Senado pelo PL do Rio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro postponed the announcement of the PL's Senate candidate for Rio de Janeiro, originally expected this Friday, to first consult with former President Jair Bolsonaro. Carlos Portinho and Carlos Jordy, both PL members and frontrunners, are awaiting the final decision. Portinho is favored by the state party leadership for his ties with inland mayors, while Jordy is preferred by the Bolsonaro family for his ideological alignment.

item.title: Lula acelera entregas com ministros antes de restrição eleitoral
item.description: President Lula convened his vice president Alckmin and several ministers for a nationwide inauguration tour across 12 cities in 8 states, marking the final day before electoral law bans institutional advertising. The deliveries emphasized new federal institutes, health equipment, and infrastructure, including five IFs in São Paulo. Lula praised the investments as vital for development, rejecting the notion that public funds are surplus and asserting that 'good money is invested in work, education, health, railways, highways, and waterways'.

item.title: PT reserva mais de R$ 120 milhões do fundo eleitoral para campanha de Lula
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) has allocated over R$ 120 million from the electoral fund for President Lula's re-election campaign, in addition to resources for federal deputy and senatorial candidates. The party will receive a total of approximately R$ 4.9 billion from the electoral fund. This allocation aims to strengthen Lula's presidential bid and the party's parliamentary candidacies in the 2026 elections.

item.title: ‘Uma bomba prestes a explodir’: o fator de risco na nova crise da família Bolsonaro
item.description: The growing rift between Michelle and Flávio Bolsonaro is damaging the senator’s image among female voters, a key demographic for the 2026 election, as allies like Paulo Figueiredo generate reputational harm due to his delayed public response. Poor turnout by conservative female leaders at a women-focused event highlights Flávio’s struggle to gain traction in this decisive segment, while long-standing family tensions, already accumulated by Michelle, remain at the core of the bolsonarist instability.

item.title: Sem citar nomes, Lula insinua que Bolsonaro “mentiu” durante campanha
item.description: Lula implied that Bolsonaro lied during the 2022 campaign by criticizing the failure to deliver the Verde e Amarela housing program, stating that governing is about delivering results, not just making promises. He also sent a message to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, declaring 2026 'the year of truth' and that lies will not be tolerated in the country. The president announced investments in education, health, and housing across 12 states, emphasizing federal institute creation and public network expansion.

item.title: PF prepara envio ao STF de conclusões sobre as fraudes no INSS e o Caso Master
item.description: The Federal Police is preparing to deliver to the Supreme Federal Court the first conclusions of investigations into improper deductions in INSS pensions and financial crimes linked to the defunct Banco Master. Both inquiries are under the rapporteurship of Justice André Mendonça. The INSS report is expected to be finalized this month, with the Master report to follow 'very soon'.

item.title: Bolsonarismo se muda para os EUA e terceiriza a própria campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is centralizing his pre-campaign in the United States, seeking inspiration and guidance from Donald Trump and Marco Rubio’s policies, particularly on taxation, Pix, factions, and sanctions. This shift reflects an effort to outsource electoral strategy to U.S. figures, making their decisions the gravitational center of Brazil’s pre-election contest.

item.title: Carta de Flávio a Trump alimenta disputa política com Lula, e cientista político vê vantagem para um dos lados
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) sent a letter to the U.S. government urging a delay in new tariffs on Brazilian products until after the 2026 elections, arguing that immediate tariffs would electorally benefit President Lula. Lula responded by accusing the Bolsonaro family of acting against national interests, calling them 'traitors of the homeland' and claiming they were submitting Brazil to foreign interests. Political scientist Elias Tavares assessed that the incident has become part of the 2026 electoral dispute, allowing Lula to frame the trade issue as a matter of national sovereignty and strengthen the narrative that the Bolsonaros serve foreign agendas.

item.title: PT boicota Marília, mas nunca elegeu senador por Minas Gerais desde que foi criado, em 1980
item.description: The PT is attempting to boycott Marília Campos's pre-candidacy for the Senate in Minas Gerais, pressuring her to run for governor despite her leading in Senate polls. Since its founding in 1980, the PT has never elected a senator from Minas Gerais, and in 2018 Dilma Rousseff led polls but finished fourth. Marília has refused to run for governor, stating her only availability is for the Senate, creating tension with Lula and the party leadership.

item.title: O que a carta de Flávio Bolsonaro aos EUA sinaliza para empresas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro sent a letter to the U.S. in addition to his public testimony before the USTR regarding the proposed 25% surcharge on Brazilian goods. The document aims to influence the U.S. trade decision, defending national productive interests and signaling concern over supply chain impacts and competitiveness for Brazilian companies. The move reflects a strategy of direct engagement with U.S. authorities to mitigate anticipated tariff risks ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Chega de fita, placa e político sorrindo
item.description: At the inauguration of the Major Sales Tunnel — part of the São Francisco River Transposition project in Rio Grande do Norte — President Lula criticized Brazil’s electoral law that bars candidates from attending public works inaugurations, calling it contradictory to the need to showcase government achievements. He lamented that the project, which took decades and was plagued by cost overruns, is finally complete, yet politicians cannot publicly associate with it during election periods.

item.title: Agência do marqueteiro de Eduardo Leite vence licitação no RS
item.description: The House of Creativity (HOC), linked to Fábio Bernardi — the strategist behind Eduardo Leite’s campaigns — won the Rio Grande do Sul government’s tender for digital communication of the Piratini Palace, alongside Escala, which already holds advertising contracts with the state. Together, the two firms will receive over R$15.6 million in the first year, with possible extension, to manage social media, content production, and data intelligence for the state government. Although the tender emphasized technical criteria and impartiality safeguards, the win by agencies with direct political ties to the governor raises concerns about potential favoritism, particularly since one already works for the government and the other is tied to the governor’s political strategist.

item.title: Vá para os EUA para ver se você tem isso [saúde gratuita] e ambulância de graça, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil's Unified Health System (SUS) is a model for the United States, citing the case of an American journalist's son who received free medical treatment after an accident in Brazil. He questioned whether such universal care would occur in the U.S. under Donald Trump's government, emphasizing the universality of Brazil's public health system.

item.title: Fachin antecipa julgamento que definirá sucessão no governo do Rio
item.description: Supreme Court President Edson Fachin moved up the ruling on Rio de Janeiro’s gubernatorial succession to August 19, determining whether the election will be direct or indirect and if the candidacy incompatibility period can be reduced to 24 hours. The judgment, resumed with Flávio Dino’s vote, currently stands at four votes for indirect election and one for direct. The decision comes amid an institutional crisis in the state, marked by resignations, arrests, and vacancies in the governor, vice-governor, and state legislature president posts.

item.title: Crusoé: Lula inova com “ponte-contêiner” no Nordeste
item.description: President Lula inaugurated a 6.5-kilometer section of the Major Sales tunnel in Rio Grande do Norte, promising that water from the São Francisco River would reach the region despite delays in the project. During the event, he highlighted the innovation of the so-called 'container bridge' as a solution for water supply in the Northeast, although water has not yet arrived at the site.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que irá aos EUA para defender Pix diante de Trump
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro announced he will travel to the United States to defend the Pix payment system before Donald Trump, criticizing President Lula for allegedly neglecting Brazilian businesses. He emphasized that Pix was created during his father Jair Bolsonaro’s administration without fees and that his trip aims to support Brazil’s payment infrastructure. The statement comes amid ongoing U.S.-Brazil trade tensions, including tariffs on Brazilian imports and sanctions on criminal groups linked to his prior visits to the U.S.

item.title: Lula inaugura hospital com nome da mãe, Dona Lindu
item.description: President Lula inaugurated the Dona Lindu Oncological Hospital in Garanhuns (PE), honoring his mother, and announced investments in health, education, and housing across 12 states, one day before the electoral blackout began. The announcements included R$ 464.8 million for health, R$ 206.6 million for 10 new federal technical education campuses, and 1,620 homes under the Minha Casa, Minha Vida program.

item.title: Após inaugurar túnel seco, Lula diz que água só chegou meia-noite
item.description: President Lula expressed disappointment that the water from the São Francisco River transposition project arrived only at midnight after the inauguration of the Major Sales Tunnel in Rio Grande do Norte, which took place on Thursday (July 2), after he had already left the ceremony. He said he had seen the water during the helicopter ride and urged residents to record its arrival as a symbolic moment of relief for the Northeast. The remarks were made during an announcement of investments in health, education, and housing, one day before the electoral blackout period began, which restricts government institutional advertising and new policy announcements.

item.title: Entidades acusam EBC de 'censurar o jornalismo público' por tirar notícias do ar em período eleitoral
item.description: The Brazilian public broadcaster EBC removed news and posts published since January 2023 covering politics and government, citing the need to comply with strict TSE guidelines during the electoral 'defeso' period. Journalist associations accused the move of censoring public journalism and undermining transparency ahead of the 2026 elections. The decision, revealed by columnist Bernardo Mello Franco, provoked strong backlash from media professionals.

item.title: Michelle enaltece política do governo Lula, após briga com Flávio
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro praised the National Policy of Bilingual Education for the Deaf, launched by the Ministry of Education under President Lula’s government, highlighting its role in promoting autonomy and leadership for the deaf community. Despite her public disagreement with her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro, she used her social media to congratulate the initiative, which aims to improve access, retention, and learning outcomes for deaf students in Brazil.

item.title: Moraes autoriza transferência de joias apreendidas em caso envolvendo Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized the transfer of custody of jewelry seized in the investigation into the alleged diversion of Saudi jewelry involving former President Jair Bolsonaro to the Brazilian Federal Revenue Service. The decision grants a request from the 8th Fiscal Region Superintendency of the Federal Revenue Service, which sought control over the seized assets in the case.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Flávio Bolsonaro é aconselhado a formar chapa com evangélica | BASTIDORES CNN
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, is being advised by allies to form an electoral ticket with an evangelical candidate for the 2026 elections. The strategy aims to strengthen support from the conservative religious base, considered crucial for the right's success in future elections. The guidance emerges amid internal debates on how to consolidate the Bolsonarist electorate following the 2022 defeats.

item.title: Kassio se reunirá com institutos e big techs após suspender pesquisa Atlas
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques has scheduled meetings with polling institutes and big techs to discuss electoral poll rules and disinformation countermeasures, following the suspension of an AtlasIntel poll showing a drop in Flávio Bolsonaro’s voting intentions. The meetings occur amid validation of electoral rules, including a ban on AI use in the final campaign stretch and immediate removal of content attacking democracy. The AtlasIntel poll was suspended due to alleged methodological bias after playing an audio of Flávio Bolsonaro requesting payments from banker Daniel Vorcaro for a pro-Jair Bolsonaro film.

item.title: Flávio propõe aos EUA blindar Pix de sistemas “não ocidentais”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro proposed to the USTR a legislative commitment to block Pix's interconnection with 'non-Western' payment systems in exchange for delaying a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods by 180 days. He argues Pix is a public infrastructure not competing with U.S. firms and that tariffs would harm U.S. investments in Brazil while boosting Lula politically. The proposal was submitted on the final day of the USTR comment period for its Section 301 trade investigation against Brazil.

item.title: Brasil x Noruega: onde apostar, melhores ofertas e odds
item.description: Brazil faces Norway in the Round of 16 of the 2026 World Cup on July 5, with multiple betting sites offering promotions such as boosted odds and free bets for new users. Offers include specific markets like player performances (Vinícius Jr. and Matheus Cunha) and team outcomes (qualification, goals, double chance).

item.title: Fala de Paulo Figueiredo ocorre na esteira de investidas contra o voto feminino nos EUA e no Brasil
item.description: Paulo Figueiredo, YouTuber and son of former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro, faced criticism for claiming that women do not know how to vote, in statements made amid efforts to undermine women's voting rights in the U.S. and Brazil. His remarks echoed outdated arguments similar to those of 19th-century U.S. Senator George Vest, reinforcing gender stereotypes in politics. The statement drew widespread backlash for being sexist and antidemocratic.

item.title: Flávio diz que Lula é o único que quer tarifaço contra o Brasil
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro accused President Lula of being the only one seeking U.S. tariffs against Brazil, claiming Lula provoked the U.S. by refusing to label Brazilian criminal factions as terrorists and lobbying for PCC and Comando Vermelho. He said he defends Brazil’s Pix system and will travel to the U.S. on July 6 to urge the cancellation of 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods. Lula responded by calling the Bolsonaro family’s actions 'entreguismo' and accused them of submitting Brazil to U.S. interests.

item.title: Conselho de Comunicação Social debate segurança de jornalistas nas eleições; participe
item.description: The Social Communication Council of the National Congress is holding an interactive public hearing on Monday (6) regarding the safety of journalists covering the 2026 elections. The debate, taking place in Plenary 7 of the Senate Federal, will bring together experts and representatives from organizations defending freedom of expression and the rights of communication professionals.

item.title: Comissão debate a pauta da infância e da adolescência nas eleições de 2026; participe
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Human Rights, Minorities and Racial Equality Commission is holding a public hearing on Tuesday (7) on childhood and adolescence in the 2026 elections, at the request of Deputy Erika Kokay (PT-DF). The debate aims to increase visibility for children's and adolescents' rights in national political discourse, foster dialogue between government branches and civil society, and present proposals from the Agenda 227 movement. The meeting will be at 10 a.m. in a plenary to be defined, with open invitation to submit questions.

item.title: Crusoé: Alfredo Gaspar lidera disputa pelo Senado em Alagoas, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Paraná Institute poll released on April 3 shows federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) leading the Senate race in Alagoas with 40.4% of voter intentions. He is closely followed by Arthur Lira (PP-AL), former Chamber of Deputies president, at 39.8%, and Renan Calheiros (MDB-AL), former Senate president, at 36.4%. The three candidates are technically tied within the margin of error.

item.title: O líder político mais rejeitado do Brasil, segundo nova pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) is Brazil's most rejected political leader, with 90% negative image, according to an AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll released July 3, 2026. Chamber President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB) and federal deputy Aécio Neves (PSDB-MG) follow with 88% rejection each. The survey interviewed 4,999 voters between June 26 and 30, with a 1-point margin of error.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Flávio Bolsonaro deixa busca por vice em 2° plano | LIVE CNN
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, stated that selecting a running mate for a potential 2026 presidential bid is currently a low priority, focusing instead on consolidating his electoral base and emphasizing issues like security and the economy. The comment was made during a CNN Brasil live broadcast, where he avoided specifying potential party alliances. The approach reflects a cautious strategy amid ongoing uncertainty in Brazil's political landscape.

item.title: Bolsonaro não pretende manter em casa a arma apreendida em blitz, diz defesa
item.description: Bolsonaro's defense told Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes that the ex-president does not want to keep the firearm seized during a traffic blitz at his home, contradicting his earlier statement that he needed to remain armed. The Glock pistol was found with an Army sergeant during a police stop in Taguatinga, and although the district police concluded Bolsonaro bore no responsibility, Moraes must soon decide whether Bolsonaro returns to the Papudinha prison or remains under house arrest. The PGR had previously supported maintaining house arrest with the weapon confiscated.

item.title: Flávio falará sobre tarifas em audiência nos EUA no dia 7 de julho
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for president, will speak at a USTR public hearing in Washington D.C. on July 7 to challenge a U.S. trade investigation that could impose new tariffs on Brazil. He will seek to suspend the measures and propose a negotiated resolution, arguing the tariffs would benefit President Lula’s government. The Brazilian government will not send representatives, viewing the hearing as a private-sector and civil society matter.

item.title: Fachin marca retomada de julgamento sobre eleição para mandato-tampão no RJ
item.description: Supreme Federal Court President Minister Edson Fachin set August 26 for the resumption of the trial on PSD's actions regarding the interim governor and vice-governor election in Rio de Janeiro. The decision was made on August 2, following Minister Flávio Dino's release of the actions for judgment on July 30.

item.title: Indefinição no Rio prejudica Flávio Bolsonaro em seu berço eleitoral
item.description: The uncertainty over Rio de Janeiro’s state government, still led by Judge Ricardo Couto, undermines Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign in his electoral base, as it keeps the PL out of power and weakens his political machine. While Eduardo Paes (PSD), an ally of Lula, leads with 43% voter intention, the candidate backed by Flávio Bolsonaro trails at 11%, highlighting the decline of Bolsonarism in Rio amid PF investigations and internal party disputes.

item.title: Em nova ofensiva, Flávio defende Pix e promete fechar portas para ‘não ocidentais’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro defended Pix in a document sent to the USTR, arguing it does not fully replace credit and debit cards, and proposed a legislative commitment to prevent Pix from interconnecting with non-Western international payment platforms. He also urged the delay of U.S. tariffs on Brazil, claiming sanctions on Pix would harm American investments. He rebutted Trump-era criticism by asserting that the alleged conflict of interest involving the Central Bank is exaggerated, comparing Pix’s role to that of the Federal Reserve in the U.S.

item.title: Crusoé: Nordeste menos vermelho
item.description: Latest polls suggest that the PT's hegemony in Brazil's Northeast, the country's second most populous region, may face a significant challenge in the 2026 elections. Opposition candidates to those backed by the PT are showing competitiveness or real chances of winning in states such as Bahia, Ceará, Alagoas, Maranhão, Paraíba, Sergipe, and Pernambuco, indicating a potential weakening of the lulopetista dominance in the region.
